page.layout: One printed page with a running head at the top, one text column in the centre, and marginal notes at the left margin beside lines 7 and 8 of the text ("7. Secunda", "8. Tertia"). Digitiser's banner at the bottom right is left out.

main_text.l: nonnullis. Cæteros autem sic à laicis di-
stinguebant ut non essent quidem ἐν κλήρῳ κατα-γεγραμμένοι,
quoniam χειροθεσίαν non habebant, ut loquitur 2. canon Chalced. synod.
qui etiam dicuntur οἱ ἐν ἐκκλησιαστικῷ τάγματι ejusdem synod. can. 6. & κατάλεγ-
μένοι can. 10. & εἰς ἐκκλησίαν πλήντες can. 20. sed illa generali appellatione dicerentur ἐν τῷ κανόνι
ἐξεταζόμενοι, ut Nicen. synod. can. 14. & οἱ τῶν κανόνων
Chalced. synod. can. 2. Secundo κανῶν λειτουργίας,
à quibusdam Græcis Theologis & Latinis
recentioribus certa benedictionis cœnæ mysticæ
formulam denotat. Tertio κανὼν
est positus; pro fidelium episcoporum & præ-
sertim Martyrum catalogo, quorum in
solemnibus precibus memoria celebrabatur;
cujus consuetudinis aliqua vestigia in Græcæ
& Latinæ liturgiæ canone adhuc reti-
nentur. Hunc autem olim etiam morem
fuisse ex quorundam veterum Theologo-
rum scriptis liquido constat, & ex recen-
tioribus scriptoribus Nicephorus præsertim
multis explicat lib. 14. cap. 25. & 26. ubi
contentionem illam narrat de Chrysostomi
nomine in Mysticas tabulas referendo, inde factum arbitror, ut
canonizati dicti sint, quorum memoria publico Ecclesiæ con-
sensu celebrabatur; unde orta tandem divorum

page.notes: The Greek words are printed in a small, partly worn type and are transcribed as far as legible; the Greek in the first lines and the lower part of the column are doubtful. The word at the end of the column, "vorum", is printed with a capital V-like initial and is read as "vorum" (continuing on the next page as "divorum"). Marginal notes "7.Secunda" and "8.Tertia" are the printed side notes.
